pax_rpg_gate_hint: E — back to the world map
pax_rpg_controls:
WASD — step (facing the camera) · Shift — run · Mouse — camera · Wheel — zoom · Q / MMB — lock on · M — city map · T — Quake (costs posture) · V — Iai: time stop
LMB — strike (three in a row — combo; on a staggered enemy — deathblow) · RMB — block, press as the blow lands — parry · Alt — dodge · Space — jump · F — draw / sheathe · C — cape · R — elixir · H — this window · Esc — menu (pause)
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_1: The road winds through blue forests. Ahead lies {city}.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_2: Pink mana clouds sink lower. You enter {city}.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_3: The guards at the gate watch you pass. {city} does not like strangers.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_4: Mana mist trembles over the roofs. {city} greets you with the noise of its streets.
pax_rpg_narrator_leave_1: You leave the city. The world of Yuruma lies before you again.
pax_rpg_narrator_leave_2: The gate closes behind you. Where now?
pax_rpg_arena_next: Victory! The crowd roars. The gates are up — you are free to go · E — next fight: %s
pax_rpg_arena_champion: Gharrok is down — you are the arena champion! The gates are up — you are free to go · E — fight the champion again
pax_rpg_arena_lost: You are carried off the sand…
pax_rpg_inv_hint: LMB — equip / remove   ·   Drag the hero — rotate   ·   TAB — close
pax_rpg_char_black_knight_moves: Heavy combo (three hits, the last all around) · Block and parry · Dodge · Deathblow
pax_rpg_char_black_knight_lore: Heavy armour and the two-handed Cleaver. Slow, but stands through blows that fell others.
pax_rpg_wskill_combo_desc: LMB three times: two wide swings and an overhead slam. The last hit strikes all around and knocks back.
pax_rpg_wskill_rift_desc: V (extra slot): the blade is driven into the ground; a wave of cracks and spikes throws enemies up.
pax_rpg_wskill_guard_desc: RMB: the blade covers the body. The first split second is a parry.
pax_rpg_wskill_iai_desc: V: time freezes, the blade is drawn — enemies on screen are cut when the tsuba clicks against the sheath.
pax_rpg_char_weapon_note: Special abilities belong to weapons: Rift to the Cleaver, Iai to the katana
pax_rpg_talk_placeholder: What do you say? (Enter — say, Esc — leave)
pax_rpg_talk_hint: Type a line. The manner above the field is how you say it (optional); what you say they read from your words.

pax_rpg_talk_manner_tip: How you say it. The meaning comes from your words: a threat in the «Flatter» manner sounds like mockery.
pax_rpg_quest_new: New quest: find the «%s» in the forest near the city. Marked on the world map.
pax_rpg_quest_found: Found: %s. Bring it back — %s waits in town.
pax_rpg_talk_give_line: Here — your %s. Found it in the forest.
pax_rpg_journal_how: Talk to the townsfolk and ask for work — the «Quest» manner or words like «any work?».
pax_rpg_journal_todo_active: Go to the forest: the «❖ Quest» mark on the world map. Goblins guard the item.
pax_rpg_journal_todo_found: Return to %s (%s): a golden ❖ above them. In the talk — the «Give» button.
pax_rpg_talk_silent: %s stays silent, looking past you. (The AI did not answer — try again.)
pax_rpg_talk_city_about: Gharn is the capital of a goblin khanate in the steppe: yurts and wooden houses around the khan's stone palace, a market by the dragon fountain, an arena where warriors fight for glory on feast days, a palisade and the Fang gate. It smells of smoke, kumis and dung; the khan's guards are hard on strangers.
pax_rpg_talk_hero_looks: a foreigner in black plate with a huge two-handed sword on the back and a katana at the hip; speaks little, carries himself like a warrior
pax_rpg_arena_way_down: Arena · stairs down on the east and west (gaps in the fence by the lanterns)
pax_rpg_wskill_ult_desc: A running overhead blow drives the blade into the ground — first wave. Rising on the hilt, a forward roll and a lunge — the second blow: twice the damage and reach, earthquake waves.
pax_rpg_set_foe_voice_note: The orc champion sometimes speaks to you in battle — as a subtitle and aloud. Each line is a separate request to the AI: it spends extra tokens (and the local model's video memory). Only for immersion; it does not affect the game.
pax_rpg_out_of_breath: Out of breath — step back or parry
pax_rpg_char_tian_long_moves: Crimson Sunset Spear · Quick thrusts and spins · Dodge · Block
pax_rpg_wskill_spear_ult_desc: A thrust stuns the target, a spinning blow knocks it back; sliding with the spear scraping the ground, the hero trips the foe and strikes its back as it rises.
